action.name: Translate

hint.pick_region: Drag to select the area to translate, Esc to cancel
form.title: Enter text to translate
panel.title: Translate
opt.providers.help: Order defines card order; keep at least one. MyMemory is a free public API with a limited anonymous quota and occasional busy errors; keep only Alibaba/Volcengine if you prefer
opt.dict_mode.help: Auto: show an extra dictionary card when the input is an English word or 1–4 CJK characters
opt.custom_providers.help: One HTTPS endpoint per row. url supports {text}, {text_q}, {from}, {to}; body uses {text_json}; result_path such as data.translation; headers is JSON and may reference the secret below via {key}.
opt.custom_api_key.help: Stored in the system keychain and used by {key} in headers; save an empty value to clear.
opt.multi_panel.help: When enabled, different texts keep separate result panels; re-translating the same text updates its panel.
